explanation: Regular expressions provide a powerful and concise way to search, match, and manipulate strings.  They are crucial for tasks like input validation, data extraction from text files (log files, configuration files), and text processing in general.  C++ utilizes the `<regex>` library for this purpose.  Best practices involve careful design of the regular expression to ensure correctness and efficiency, and handling potential exceptions during matching operations. Common pitfalls include overly complex or ambiguous regex patterns leading to unexpected matches or performance issues.
keywords: C++ regex, Regular expressions C++, <regex> library, C++ string matching
